usage: The word '行' (haang4) is used to describe the action of walking.
'行' can be used with time expressions to talk about walking at a certain time.
You can use '行' with directions to indicate where someone is walking.
'行' can be used in questions to ask if someone wants to walk or can walk.
'行' can also describe the possibility or ability to walk in some contexts.
